builtins.label: `print`
unsupported: file= other than sys.stdout or sys.stderr

builtins.label: `bytes`, `bytearray`, `memoryview`, `callable`, `complex`, `dict`, `format`, `tuple`, `type`, `object`, `super`, `vars`, `dir`, `globals`, `locals`, `exec`, `issubclass`, `ascii`, `setattr`, `delattr`, `slice`, `hash`, `__import__`
unsupported: all (`dict` displays and `{}` work; `dict(...)` does not)
builtins.note: all (`dict` displays and `{}` work; `dict(...)` does not)

stdlib.label: `math`
unsupported: fsum, comb, perm, isqrt, copysign, cbrt, prod, erf, erfc, lgamma, gamma, log with a base

stdlib.label: `re`
unsupported: finditer, 5+ groups, sub with a function

stdlib.label: `dotenv`
unsupported: stream, verbose, interpolate, override, encoding arguments, other dotenv members (find_dotenv, set_key, DotEnv), interpolation ($VAR stays literal)

stdlib.label: `jwt`
unsupported: RS256 and other asymmetric algorithms, non-literal algorithm, other jwt members (get_unverified_header, PyJWTError), claims beyond str values (exp, aud), options dict, headers argument

stdlib.label: `orjson`
unsupported: default callable, other OPT_ flags, other orjson members (Fragment, JSONDecodeError)

stdlib.label: `urllib.request`, `urllib.error`
unsupported: urlopen header keyword, other urllib.request members (build_opener, install_opener, urlretrieve), HTTPError attribute reads

stdlib.label: `hashlib`
unsupported: blake2, sha3, sha224, new, pbkdf2_hmac, incremental update (no-argument constructor)

stdlib.label: `struct`
unsupported: non-literal format, native-alignment format (no byte-order prefix), pack_into, iter_unpack, Struct

stdlib.label: `functools`
unsupported: reduce with a lambda, reduce with an initializer, partial, wraps, lru_cache, cmp_to_key, cache, total_ordering

stdlib.label: `itertools`
unsupported: count, cycle (infinite), tee (returns a pair, not an iterator), permutations without a count

stdlib.label: `operator`
unsupported: itemgetter, attrgetter, methodcaller, and_, not_, getitem

stdlib.label: `os`
unsupported: scandir, system, urandom, cpu_count, kill, rmdir, getuid, keyword arguments (makedirs exist_ok)

stdlib.label: `pathlib`
unsupported: rglob, absolute, rmdir, with_suffix, relative_to, resolve to str, PurePath

stdlib.label: `sys`
unsupported: stdin, path, modules, getsizeof, getrecursionlimit, stdout.flush

stdlib.label: `threading`
unsupported: main_thread, Thread target is a callable, Timer, Lock in `with`

stdlib.label: `queue`
unsupported: PriorityQueue, a queue without an element annotation, an unknown queue method, a bool element type

stdlib.label: `logging`
unsupported: basicConfig(level=...), format args (`logging.info(fmt, a)`), exception, handlers (StreamHandler)

stdlib.label: `asyncio`
unsupported: bare Queue annotation (element type needed), get_event_loop, sleep outside a coroutine

stdlib.label: `ctypes`
unsupported: CDLL, c_int(...), sizeof of other types

stdlib.label: `statistics`
unsupported: multimode, median_grouped, correlation, linear_regression, mode over float data, quantiles n= outside 2, 4, 8

stdlib.label: `uuid`
unsupported: .int, .urn, .bytes and other names, names outside the subset

stdlib.label: `binascii`
unsupported: hexlify of str, names outside the subset

stdlib.label: `shlex`
unsupported: comments as a variable, the shlex class and modes

stdlib.label: `secrets`
unsupported: the count as a variable, names outside the subset

stdlib.label: `atexit`
unsupported: register of a function with arguments, unregister

stdlib.label: `enum`
unsupported: Flag, str-valued members, methods on the enum

stdlib.label: `dataclasses`
unsupported: field(), asdict, order= and other options

stdlib.label: `selectors`
unsupported: a fileobj argument (the typed socket handle is #229), other selector classes (EpollSelector, PollSelector, KqueueSelector, DevpollSelector, BaseSelector), get_map, the key's fileobj and data (they ride the #229 handle)

stdlib.label: `typing`, `typing_extensions`
unsupported: Any annotation, bare Callable, multi-arm union, optional of a multi-arm union, Literal annotation, Self return, TypeAlias declaration, PEP 695 type alias, PEP 695 TypeVar parameter, forward reference string, TypedDict class base, NamedTuple class base, NewType value, ParamSpec value, cast value, get_type_hints reflection, isinstance with a generic, __annotations__ read
stdlib.note: annotation-only: imports are free, annotations are the lowering input, erased before emission; typing names used as values fence
